name: io.github.ashergarland/agent-tool-server-azure
description: Inspect, diagnose, operate and deploy Azure through a guard-railed control plane

environmentVariables.name: AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Azure subscription ids the server may touch. Leave unset to allow every subscription the signed-in identity can already see.

environmentVariables.name: AZURE_ALLOWED_RESOURCE_GROUPS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated resource group names the server may touch. Empty means every group inside the allowed subscriptions.

environmentVariables.name: AZURE_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client id of the user-assigned managed identity used for reads and operations. Omit locally to use the ambient az login session.

environmentVariables.name: AZURE_TENANT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Entra tenant id, when the ambient credential resolves more than one tenant.

environmentVariables.name: MUTATIONS_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable the four guarded state-changing tools. Disabled by default; dry runs always work.

environmentVariables.name: DEPLOYMENTS_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable generic Bicep validate, what-if, deploy, status and rollback. Disabled by default and requires a pinned Bicep CLI.

environmentVariables.name: BICEP_CLI_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the Bicep CLI installed in the image. Required when DEPLOYMENTS_ENABLED is true.

environmentVariables.name: BICEP_CLI_SHA256
environmentVariables.description: Expected SHA-256 of that Bicep CLI. The server refuses to compile if the digest does not match.

environmentVariables.name: AZURE_DEPLOYMENT_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client id of the separate user-assigned identity used only for deployments.
